_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: 1. Sign up a new venue (Account checks). Step 2, Your identity: Verify my identity opens Stripe's ID and selfie check in the app. If Stripe cannot run ID checks for Vesopa's account yet, step 2 now says Stripe checks your photo ID in the next step, and the sign-up goes on to step 3 (Business and bank checks) instead of stopping with an error. 2. Finish step 3, then the licence and the manager PIN. 3. Everything in 1.2.66 (TV remote, customer display options) still works.
release_notes: Signing up: if Stripe cannot check your ID on its own, it checks it with the business and bank checks, so signing up no longer stops at the identity step. Stripe's 3D face capture is included on iPhone and iPad.
